blind.description: A stylized stone sarcophagus or tomb coffer featuring a gabled/ridged lid with protruding end caps and a central carved relief emblem resembling a winged sun disk or scarab/sun motif. The body has framed architectural panels along the sides separated by small pilasters, each panel containing a raised circular medallion. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and continuous with hand-painted stylized textures indicating weathered sandstone/limestone with faint greenish moss/lichen patina. It sits directly on its own flat-bottomed molded base.
blind.from_above: A rectangular stone lid with a prominent longitudinal ridge, triangular cross-braced ends, an overhanging rim, and a centered raised sunburst-style medallion with pointed rays or stylized wings.
blind.height_vs_figure: About half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 2.5 to 3 ft tall) and roughly as long as the figure is tall (around 5.5 to 6 ft long).
